records.sql: SELECT MAX("f"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cds WHERE "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".numtsttakr > 0 AND "s".numge1500::NUMERIC / "s".numtsttakr > 0.3 AND "f"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".doctype FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f"."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded' AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" - "f"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > (SELECT AVG("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM "frpm" WHERE "Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'Unified School District')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'Elementary School District'), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "frpm" AS "f" LEFT JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode AND "s".statustype = 'Merged' WHERE "f"."County Name" = 'Orange' AND "s".statustype = 'Merged' LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".mailstreet, "s".school FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "t" ON "s".cdscode = "t".cds WHERE "t".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "t".avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "frpm" WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.18 LIMIT 501
SELECT "School Name", "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM "frpm" WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" = '9' LIMIT 501
SELECT "f"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", "f"."District Code" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".admfname1 = 'Alusine' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".admemail1 FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".admemail1 IS NOT NULL AND "s".city = 'San Bernardino' AND "s".county = 'San Bernardino' AND "s".soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)' AND "s".eilname = 'Intermediate/Middle/Junior High' AND "s".doc = '00' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '2009-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '2011-01-01' ORDER BY "s".admemail1 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "frpm".cdscode, "frpm"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", "schools".ncesschool FROM "frpm" LEFT JOIN "schools" ON "frpm".cdscode = "schools".cdscode WHERE "frpm".cdscode IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_sat_test_takers_per_school" FROM "schools" AS "sch" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "sch".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "sch".charternum = '0756' AND "sch".mailcity ILIKE 'San Diego' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".gsserved FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".ncesdist = '0613360' AND "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".eilcode = 'HS' AND "s".gsserved IS NOT NULL AND "s".gsserved ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])12([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND ("sat".cds IS NULL OR "sat".numtsttakr = 0) ORDER BY "s".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".sname, "sc".mailstreet FROM "satscores" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "s".cds = "sc".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND "sc".mailstreet IS NOT NULL AND "s".avgscrread = (SELECT MAX("s2".avgscrread) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f2" ON "s2".cds = "f2".cdscode WHERE "f2"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s2".rtype = 'S' AND "s2".avgscrread IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".city FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f".cdscode = '01611920113902' AND "f"."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "f"."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND "f"."Low Grade" = '9' AND "f"."High Grade" = '12' AND "s".eilcode = 'HS' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".city FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".eilcode = 'HS' AND "f"."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2' AND "f"."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "f"."Low Grade"::INTEGER > 9 ORDER BY "s".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "sc".school AS "school_name", "sc".phone AS "phone_number" FROM "satscores" AS "ss" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "ss".cds = "sc".cdscode WHERE "ss".rtype = 'S' AND "sc".charter = 1 AND "sc".doc = '00' AND "ss".numge1500 IS NOT NULL AND "ss".numge1500 = (SELECT MAX("ss2".numge1500) FROM "satscores" AS "ss2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc2" ON "ss2".cds = "sc2".cdscode WHERE "ss2".rtype = 'S' AND "sc2".charter = 1 AND "sc2".doc = '00' AND "ss2".numge1500 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "satscores".avgscrmath, "satscores".numtsttakr FROM "satscores" INNER JOIN "schools" ON "satscores".cds = "schools".cdscode WHERE "schools".cdscode = '01611190130609' AND "schools".charter = 1 AND "schools".fundingtype = 'Directly funded' AND "satscores".rtype = 'S' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "satscores" AS "county_school" WHERE "county_school".rtype = 'S' AND "county_school".cname = 'Contra Costa' AND "county_school".numtsttakr > (SELECT "target".numtsttakr FROM "satscores" AS "target" WHERE "target".cds = '7618040730051') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "s"."cdscode" = "sat"."cds" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s"."cdscode" = "f"."cdscode" WHERE "s"."mailcity" ILIKE 'San Francisco' AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND "sat"."rtype" = 'S' AND "sat"."avgscrread" IS NOT NULL AND "sat"."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL AND "sat"."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL AND "sat"."avgscrread" + "sat"."avgscrmath" + "sat"."avgscrwrite" >= 1500 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'Adult' THEN NULL ELSE CAST("f"."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1 END) = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'Adult' THEN NULL ELSE CAST("f"."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1 END) = 1 THEN 'K' ELSE CAST(MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'Adult' THEN NULL ELSE CAST("f"."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1 END) - 1 AS TEXT) END AS "Lowest Grade Level" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".ncesdist = '0632640' AND "f"."Low Grade" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "district_schools" AS (SELECT "f"."County Name", "f"."District Name", "f".cdscode, "s".admfname1, "s".admfname2, "s".admfname3 FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."County Name" IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education')), "name_counts" AS (SELECT first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS "school_count" FROM (SELECT cdscode, admfname1 AS "first_name" FROM "district_schools" WHERE admfname1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT cdscode, admfname2 AS "first_name" FROM "district_schools" WHERE admfname2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT cdscode, admfname3 AS "first_name" FROM "district_schools" WHERE admfname3 IS NOT NULL) AS "all_admin_names" GROUP BY first_name), "top_names" AS (SELECT first_name FROM "name_counts" ORDER BY school_count DESC, first_name ASC LIMIT 2), "district_name_counts" AS (SELECT "d"."District Name", "t".first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "t".first_name IN ("d".admfname1, "d".admfname2, "d".admfname3) THEN "d".cdscode END) AS "school_count" FROM "district_schools" AS "d" CROSS JOIN "top_names" AS "t" GROUP BY "d"."District Name", "t".first_name) SELECT "District Name", first_name, school_count FROM "district_name_counts" ORDER BY "District Name" ASC, first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((SUM(COALESCE("f"."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0)) / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_eligible_students" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".soctype = 'Youth Authority Facilities' LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."School Name", "s".eilname FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f".cdscode = '01612590136051' AND "f"."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".sname, "sc".admemail1 FROM "satscores" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "s".cds = "sc".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".numge1500 = (SELECT MAX("s2".numge1500) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f2" ON "s2".cds = "f2".cdscode WHERE "f2"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s2".rtype = 'S') LIMIT 501

WITH "middle_schools" AS (SELECT "f"."School Type", "s".school, "s".latitude FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".latitude IS NOT NULL AND ("f"."School Type" ILIKE '%middle%' OR "s".school ILIKE '%middle%' OR "s".school ILIKE '%junior high%')) SELECT "School Type", school, latitude FROM "middle_schools" WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM "middle_schools") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("ss".numtsttakr, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_sat_test_takers" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "s".cdscode = "ss".cds WHERE "s".county = 'Los Angeles' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '2008-01-01' AND "s".doc IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."Charter Funding Type" AS "funding category", COUNT(*) AS "number of charter schools", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total 2014-2015 K-12 enrollment", ROUND(AVG("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)")::NUMERIC * 100, 2) AS "average eligible FRPM percentage (0-100 scale)", ROUND((SELECT AVG(("s".avgscrread + "s".avgscrmath + "s".avgscrwrite)::NUMERIC) FROM "satscores" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f2" ON "f2".cdscode = "s".cds INNER JOIN "schools" AS "d2" ON "d2".cdscode = "f2".cdscode WHERE "f2"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f2"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "f2"."Charter Funding Type" = "f"."Charter Funding Type" AND "d2".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND "s".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND "s".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average combined SAT score" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "d" ON "d".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "f"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') AND "d".statustype = 'Active' GROUP BY "f"."Charter Funding Type" ORDER BY "f"."Charter Funding Type" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."School Name", "f"."Low Grade", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", COALESCE("s".numtsttakr, 0) AS "sat_test_takers" FROM "frpm" AS "f" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode AND "s".rtype = 'S' WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."District Type" = 'State Special Schools' AND "f"."Low Grade" IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Low Grade" <> 'Adult' ORDER BY CASE "f"."Low Grade" WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1 ELSE CAST("f"."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1 END DESC, "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST, "f"."School Name" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 AND "s".school IS NOT NULL AND "s".school <> '' AND "s".doc <> ' county' AND "s".doctype NOT ILIKE '%county office%' AND "f"."High Grade" ~ '^[1-8]$' AND ("sat".numtsttakr IS NULL OR "sat".numtsttakr = 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."Charter Funding Type", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active') AS "currently_operating_schools", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", SUM("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS "total_frpm_eligible_k12_students" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)' AND "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "f"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY "f"."Charter Funding Type" ORDER BY CASE "f"."Charter Funding Type" WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1 WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "closed_school_scores" AS (SELECT "s".school AS "school_name", "s".district AS "district_name", "s".county AS "county_name", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "avg_writing_score" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL), "second_score" AS (SELECT MAX(avg_writing_score) AS "score" FROM "closed_school_scores" WHERE avg_writing_score < (SELECT MAX(avg_writing_score) FROM "closed_school_scores")) SELECT school_name, district_name, county_name, avg_writing_score FROM "closed_school_scores" WHERE avg_writing_score = (SELECT score FROM "second_score") ORDER BY school_name ASC, district_name ASC, county_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".eilname = 'High School' AND ("sat".cds IS NULL OR "sat".numtsttakr = 0) LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "f".cdscode, "f"."County Name" AS "county_name", "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" AS "charter", ROUND(("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "free_pct", ROUND(("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "frpm_pct" FROM "frpm" AS "f" WHERE "f"."County Code" = '01' AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700), "sat_by_school" AS (SELECT cds, avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite AS "sat_total" FROM "satscores" WHERE rtype = 'S') SELECT "e".county_name AS "County Name", COUNT(*) AS "Number of Schools", ROUND(AVG("e".free_pct), 2) AS "Average Free-Meal Percentage", ROUND(AVG("e".frpm_pct), 2) AS "Average FRPM Percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".charter = 1) AS "Charter Schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".charter = 0) AS "Non-Charter Schools", ROUND(AVG("s".sat_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Average SAT Score" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "sat_by_school" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "e".cdscode GROUP BY "e".county_name LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 12 AS "average_schools_per_month" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'San Diego' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') LIMIT 501
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".virtual IN ('F', 'P')) / COUNT(*) FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "sat".avgscrmath > 400 LIMIT 501

SELECT "School Name", "County Name", "District Name", "s".city, "Enrollment (K-12)", "FRPM Count (K-12)", "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", numtsttakr, avgscrread, avgscrmath, avgscrwrite, numge1500 FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "f".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "f".cdscode, "f"."School Name" AS "school_name", "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS "free_meal_rate", "s".charter, "s".gsserved FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "s".eilname = 'High School' AND "s".gsserved IS NOT NULL AND "s".gsserved LIKE '%12%' AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), "scored" AS (SELECT "e".school_name, "e".free_meal_rate, CASE WHEN "e".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "e".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter_status", "e".gsserved, CASE WHEN "ss".cds IS NULL OR "ss".avgscrread IS NULL OR "ss".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "ss".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "ss".avgscrread + "ss".avgscrmath + "ss".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "ss".avgscrread + "ss".avgscrmath + "ss".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "sat_performance" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "ss".cds = "e".cdscode AND "ss".rtype = 'S'), "winners" AS (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS "highest_rate" FROM "scored") SELECT school_name, TO_CHAR(free_meal_rate, 'FM0.0000') AS "free_meal_rate", charter_status, gsserved, sat_performance FROM "scored" WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT highest_rate FROM "winners") LIMIT 501

SELECT "sc".school AS "name", "sc".phone, "sc".website, "sat".avgscrread AS "average_sat_reading", "sat".avgscrmath AS "average_sat_math", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "average_sat_writing", "sc".charter AS "charter_status", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment_k12_2014_2015", ROUND(("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "eligible_frpm_percent", (SELECT MAX("s2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s3" ON "s2".cds = "s3".cdscode WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Active' AND "s2".rtype = 'S' AND "s2".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "s2".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL) AS "highest_active_school_sat_math", (SELECT MAX("s2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s3" ON "s2".cds = "s3".cdscode WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Active' AND "s2".rtype = 'S' AND "s2".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "s2".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL) - "sat".avgscrmath AS "math_score_below_highest" FROM "schools" AS "sc" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "sc".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "sc".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "sc".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

WITH "virtual_schools" AS (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".county, "s".school FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".virtual = 'F'), "county_counts" AS (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "virtual_school_count" FROM "virtual_schools" GROUP BY county), "cutoff" AS (SELECT virtual_school_count FROM "county_counts" ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4), "top_counties" AS (SELECT "cc".county, "cc".virtual_school_count FROM "county_counts" AS "cc" WHERE "cc".virtual_school_count >= (SELECT virtual_school_count FROM "cutoff")), "school_reading" AS (SELECT "vs".county, "vs".school, "ss".avgscrread FROM "virtual_schools" AS "vs" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "ss".cds = "vs".cdscode AND "ss".rtype = 'S'), "county_max" AS (SELECT county, MAX(avgscrread) AS "highest_reading" FROM "school_reading" GROUP BY county) SELECT "tc".county AS "county_name", "tc".virtual_school_count, CASE WHEN "cm".highest_reading IS NULL THEN 'None' ELSE "sr".school END AS "school_name" FROM "top_counties" AS "tc" INNER JOIN "county_max" AS "cm" ON "cm".county = "tc".county LEFT JOIN "school_reading" AS "sr" ON "sr".county = "tc".county AND "sr".avgscrread = "cm".highest_reading ORDER BY "tc".virtual_school_count DESC, "tc".county ASC, school_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "exclusive_virtual_schools" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' AND county IN ('Santa Barbara', (SELECT county FROM "schools" WHERE cdscode = '01100170109835')) GROUP BY county ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, county ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".street FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "s".school IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > "f"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" + 30 AND CASE WHEN "f"."High Grade" = 'K' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."High Grade" = 'P' THEN -1 WHEN "f"."High Grade" = 'Adult' THEN 99 WHEN "f"."High Grade" = 'Post Secondary' THEN 100 ELSE CAST("f"."High Grade" AS INTEGER) END <= 8 LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."School Name", "s".street FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" - "f"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30 AND "f"."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "f"."Low Grade"::INTEGER >= 9 ORDER BY "f".cdscode ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."County Name", COUNT(DISTINCT "f".cdscode) AS "Number of Qualifying Schools" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1 AND "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".numge1500 >= 1 GROUP BY "f"."County Name" ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "f".cdscode) DESC, "f"."County Name" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".admfname1, "s".admlname1 FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "ss".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".cdscode IN (SELECT cdscode FROM "schools" WHERE cdscode = '01611430131177') AND "ss".rtype = 'S' AND "ss".numge1500 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "ss".numge1500 DESC, "s".cdscode ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT viewcount, lasteditordisplayname FROM "posts" WHERE title = 'Computer game datasets' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) AS "total_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE owneruserid IS NOT NULL) AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'United Kingdom' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".age)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_age" FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "c".userid WHERE "c".text LIKE '%http://%' AND "u".age IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".id) AS "count" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "organizer" ON "organizer".userid = "u".id AND "organizer".name = 'Organizer' WHERE "u".location = 'Germany' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "badges" AS "prior_badge" WHERE "prior_badge".userid = "u".id AND "prior_badge".date < "organizer".date) >= 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "p".owneruserid, MIN("p".creaiondate) AS "first_post_date" FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".owneruserid) AS "fp" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "fp".owneruserid WHERE "fp".first_post_date >= '2010-01-01 00:00:00+00'::TIMESTAMPTZ AND "fp".first_post_date < '2011-01-01 00:00:00+00'::TIMESTAMPTZ AND "u".location ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*India[[:space:]]*$' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)) FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".tags ILIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".score < 20 LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("p".score) FILTER (WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%'), 0) AS "germany_last_editor_posts_total_score", COALESCE(SUM("p".score) FILTER (WHERE "u".id IS NULL OR "u".location NOT ILIKE '%Germany%'), 0) AS "all_other_posts_total_score", COUNT(DISTINCT "u".id) FILTER (WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%') AS "germany_based_last_editor_user_count", COALESCE(SUM("u".reputation) FILTER (WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%'), 0) AS "combined_profile_reputation" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".lasteditoruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2013-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) FROM "users" AS "u" WHERE "u".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "p".owneruserid FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".score = 10 AND "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("linking".score), 0) AS "total_score" FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "target" ON "target".id = "pl".relatedpostid INNER JOIN "posts" AS "linking" ON "linking".id = "pl".postid WHERE "target".title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?' AND "linking".posttypeid = 1 AND "linking".tags LIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 501

WITH "germany_users" AS (SELECT id, displayname FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%Germany%'), "badge_totals" AS (SELECT "gu".id, "gu".displayname, COUNT("b".id) AS "badge_total" FROM "germany_users" AS "gu" LEFT JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "gu".id GROUP BY "gu".id, "gu".displayname), "ranked_totals" AS (SELECT badge_total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS "total_rank" FROM "badge_totals") SELECT "bt".displayname, "bt".badge_total FROM "badge_totals" AS "bt" WHERE "bt".badge_total = (SELECT MAX(badge_total) FROM "badge_totals" WHERE badge_total < (SELECT MAX(badge_total) FROM "badge_totals")) ORDER BY "bt".displayname ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT age FROM "users" WHERE (location ILIKE '%York%England%' OR location ILIKE 'York') AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%York%England%' OR location ILIKE 'York') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%India%' AND "b".name = 'Yearling' AND "b".date < '2014-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".displayname) AS "display_name_count" FROM "badges" AS "b" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "b".userid WHERE "b".name = 'Supporter' AND "u".age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 AND "u".displayname IS NOT NULL AND "u".displayname <> 'NaN' LIMIT 501

WITH "matching_posts" AS (SELECT id, title FROM "posts" WHERE title ILIKE '%principal component scores%'), "counts" AS (SELECT "mp".id, "mp".title, COUNT("pl".id) AS "related_post_count" FROM "matching_posts" AS "mp" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "pl" ON "pl".postid = "mp".id OR "pl".relatedpostid = "mp".id GROUP BY "mp".id, "mp".title), "ranked" AS (SELECT title, related_post_count, MAX(related_post_count) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "counts") SELECT title, related_post_count FROM "ranked" WHERE related_post_count = max_count LIMIT 501
SELECT id FROM "users" WHERE displayname = 'Michael' AND age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY age ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL THEN 'id:' || "p".owneruserid::TEXT ELSE 'name:' || "p".ownerdisplayname END) AS "user_count" FROM "votes" AS "v" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "v".postid WHERE "v".votetypeid IN (8, 9) AND "v".bountyamount >= 30 AND "v".creationdate >= DATE '2010-01-01' AND "v".creationdate < DATE '2011-01-01' AND ("p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(BTRIM("p".ownerdisplayname), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND owneruserid IS NOT NULL) AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'India' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("v".vote_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_up_votes_cast", ROUND(AVG("u".age::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_age" FROM (SELECT "p".owneruserid AS "userid" FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p"."creaiondate" >= '2012-01-01' AND "p"."creaiondate" < '2013-01-01' AND "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS "a" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "a".userid LEFT JOIN (SELECT userid, COUNT(*) AS "vote_count" FROM "votes" WHERE votetypeid = 2 GROUP BY userid) AS "v" ON "v".userid = "a".userid WHERE "u".age IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT "postlinks".postid) / 12.0, 2) AS "average_monthly_posts" FROM "postlinks" INNER JOIN "posts" ON "posts".id = "postlinks".postid WHERE "postlinks".creationdate >= '2010-01-01' AND "postlinks".creationdate < '2011-01-01' AND "posts".answercount <= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "u".reputation < 1000 OR "u".id IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".score > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "u".displayname, COUNT(*) AS "edit_comment_count" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "posthistory" AS "ph" ON "ph".postid = "p".id INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "ph".userid WHERE "p".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "ph".comment IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("ph".comment) <> '' GROUP BY "u".id, "u".displayname HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "posts" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "posthistory" AS "ph2" ON "ph2".postid = "p2".id INNER JOIN "users" AS "u2" ON "u2".id = "ph2".userid WHERE "p2".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "ph2".comment IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("ph2".comment) <> '' GROUP BY "u2".id, "u2".displayname) AS "counts") ORDER BY "u".displayname ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "annual" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid), "ranked" AS (SELECT segment, customerid, total_consumption, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM "annual"), "minima" AS (SELECT segment, total_consumption FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1) SELECT ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "SME minus LAM", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "LAM minus KAM", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "KAM minus SME" FROM "minima" LIMIT 501

WITH "segment_totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301) AS "consumption_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401) AS "consumption_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY "c".segment), "changes" AS (SELECT segment, (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2012 * 100 AS "increase_percentage" FROM "segment_totals") SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "changes" WHERE increase_percentage = (SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) FROM "changes") OR increase_percentage = (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) FROM "changes") ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "y".customerid, ROUND(((SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER / 100 = 2013 THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER / 100 = 2012 THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER / 100 = 2012 THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END), 0))::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" WHERE "y".customerid = 6718 AND "y".date::INTEGER / 100 IN (2012, 2013) GROUP BY "y".customerid LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y12" ON "y12".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y13" ON "y13".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y12".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y12".date::INTEGER < 201301 AND "y12".consumption > 0 AND "y13".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y13".date::INTEGER < 201401 AND "y13".consumption > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "ym".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" WHERE CAST("ym".date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212 AND "ym".customerid IN (SELECT DISTINCT "t".customerid FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" WHERE "t".date >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '2013-01-01') GROUP BY "ym".customerid HAVING SUM("ym".consumption) < 30000) AS "eligible" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "eligible".customerid GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "ym".customerid) AS "customers" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "ym" ON "ym".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "ym".date::INTEGER BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND "ym".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("t".date + "t".time::TIME) - MIN("t".date + "t".time::TIME))) / 60) AS "whole_minutes_elapsed" FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gasstations" AS "g" ON "t".gasstationid = "g".gasstationid WHERE "g".country = 'CZE' AND "t".price > 1000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT "ym".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" WHERE CAST("ym".date AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST("ym".date AS INTEGER) <= 201311 AND "ym".consumption <> 0 GROUP BY "ym".customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("ym".date AS INTEGER)) = 11) AS "active" ON "active".customerid = "c".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, ROUND(AVG("y".consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_quarterly_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "y".date::INTEGER >= 201304 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201307 AND "c".currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK') GROUP BY "c".currency ORDER BY "c".currency ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM'))::INTEGER AS "year", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM'))::INTEGER AS "month", SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM')) IN (2012, 2013) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM'))), "peaks" AS (SELECT year, MAX(total_consumption) AS "peak_total" FROM "monthly" GROUP BY year) SELECT ROUND(MAX(peak_total) FILTER (WHERE year = 2013) - MAX(peak_total) FILTER (WHERE year = 2012)) AS "difference" FROM "peaks" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "y".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND CAST("y"."date" AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST("y"."date" AS INTEGER) < 201401 GROUP BY "y".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customerid) FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "t".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'SME' AND "t".date >= DATE '2013-02-01' AND "t".date < DATE '2013-03-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

WITH "player_averages" AS (SELECT "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name, "p".height, AVG("pa".finishing) AS "average_finishing" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height IS NOT NULL AND "pa".finishing IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name, "p".height), "extremes" AS (SELECT (SELECT player_api_id FROM "player" WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM "player") ORDER BY player_api_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "tallest_id", (SELECT player_api_id FROM "player" WHERE height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM "player") ORDER BY player_api_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "shortest_id") SELECT "a".player_name FROM "player_averages" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "a".player_api_id IN ("e".tallest_id, "e".shortest_id) ORDER BY "a".average_finishing DESC LIMIT 1

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE >= DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "eligible" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "branch_district".district_id, "branch_district".a11 FROM "district" AS "branch_district" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "branch_district".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "branch_district".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_districts" FROM "qualifying_districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "district" AS "region" ON "region".district_id = "c".district_id AND "region".a3 = 'central Bohemia' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "any_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "cr" ON "cr".disp_id = "any_disp".disp_id WHERE "any_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id)) AS "client_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "client_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "a".account_id, COUNT("lo".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "lo" ON "lo".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "counterparties" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS "outside_counterparties" FROM "trans" WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> 0 GROUP BY account_id), "households" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".outside_counterparties, 0) AS "outside_counterparties", "d".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "d".a11 AS "district_population" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "borrowing" AS "b" ON "b".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "owner_client" ON "owner_client".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "owner_client".district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice') SELECT account_id, opening_date, total_borrowed, outside_counterparties, owner_home_district, district_population, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS "rank" FROM "households" ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "cl".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "card_disp" ON "card_disp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "card_disp".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "card_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "card_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold' AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000 AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000), "with_max" AS (SELECT gender, MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM "qualifying_districts" GROUP BY gender), "summary" AS (SELECT "q".gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG("q".urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q" GROUP BY "q".gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "q".district_id, "q".inhabitants, "s".average_salary, "s".average_urban_ratio FROM "summary" AS "s" INNER JOIN "with_max" AS "m" ON "m".gender = "s".gender INNER JOIN "qualifying_districts" AS "q" ON "q".gender = "s".gender AND "q".inhabitants = "m".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "q".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "owner_disp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payments, total_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS "total_rank" FROM "pair_totals") SELECT bank AS "recipient_bank_code", account AS "recipient_counter_account_number", outgoing_payments AS "number_of_outgoing_payments", total_amount AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "ranked" WHERE total_rank = 1 ORDER BY bank ASC, account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "d".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "regional_districts" AS (SELECT "x".district_id, "x".a3 AS "region", "x".a2 AS "district_name", "x".a4::NUMERIC AS "inhabitants", "x".a11 AS "salary", "x".a12 AS "unemployment_1996" FROM "district" AS "x" INNER JOIN "eligible_districts" AS "e" ON "e".district_id = "x".district_id), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT region, district_id, district_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC) AS "rn" FROM "regional_districts") SELECT "r".region, ROUND(AVG("rd".salary), 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("rd".unemployment_1996::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", "r".district_name AS "most_populous_district" FROM "ranked_districts" AS "r" INNER JOIN "regional_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".region = "r".region WHERE "r".rn = 1 GROUP BY "r".region, "r".district_name ORDER BY "r".region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "crime" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3, "d".a4::INTEGER AS "inhabitants", COUNT("t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01') AS "crime_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4), "top_three" AS (SELECT * FROM "crime" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, translate(lower(district_name), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 3) SELECT district_name, crime_count, ROUND(AVG(crime_count) OVER (), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) FROM "crime"), 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND(AVG(crime_count) OVER () - (SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) FROM "crime"), 2) AS "difference" FROM "top_three" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, translate(lower(district_name), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca".type AS "card_type", "c".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id), "district_markets" AS (SELECT "cd".card_type, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "home_district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card_districts" AS "cd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cd".district_id) SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants FROM "district_markets" AS "dm" WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MIN(inhabitants) FROM "district_markets" WHERE card_type = "dm".card_type) ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 ILIKE '%Litomerice%'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "target_region" AS "r" ON "r".a3 = "d".a3 WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "last_trans" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "acct_balances" AS (SELECT "o".account_id, "o".district_id, "o".district_name, "lt".balance FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "last_trans" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id), "district_stats" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", ROUND(AVG(balance::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_end_1996_balance", AVG(balance::NUMERIC) AS "raw_average" FROM "acct_balances" GROUP BY district_id, district_name), "region_avg" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance::NUMERIC), 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_1996_balance" FROM "acct_balances"), "highest" AS (SELECT district_name AS "highest_average_balance_district" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY raw_average DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "ds".district_name, "ds".accounts_opened, "ds".average_end_1996_balance, "ra".region_wide_average_end_1996_balance, "h".highest_average_balance_district FROM "district_stats" AS "ds" CROSS JOIN "region_avg" AS "ra" CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" ORDER BY "ds".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "district_set" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "top_loans"), "stats" AS (SELECT "ds".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_yearly_salary" FROM "district_set" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ds".district_id) SELECT (SELECT district_id FROM "stats" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "district_id", (SELECT inhabitants FROM "stats" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(average_yearly_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary_across_districts" FROM "stats" LIMIT 501

WITH "withdrawal_totals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "standing_order_totals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "standing_order_debit" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", "s".standing_order_debit::NUMERIC / COUNT("a".account_id) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "withdrawal_totals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "standing_order_totals" AS "s" ON "s".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4, "w".total_withdrawn, "s".standing_order_debit) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_metrics" ORDER BY rank ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_home" AS (SELECT district_id FROM "client" WHERE client_id = 3541), "accessible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 3541), "tx" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "region_clients" AS (SELECT "dh".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "dh" ON "dh".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "dh".a3), "regional_population" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "inhabitants", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a11 DESC, "d".district_id ASC) AS "pop_order", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a11 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district" AS "d") SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".frequency, "ad".a2, "ad".a3, CASE WHEN "ad".district_id = "ch".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END, "ad".a12, COALESCE("l".status, 'none'), COALESCE("l".amount, 0), COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0), COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0), COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0), COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0), "rc".client_count, "rp".district_name, "rp".inhabitants, "ar".population_rank FROM "accessible" AS "x" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "x".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id CROSS JOIN "client_home" AS "ch" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "region_clients" AS "rc" ON "rc".region = "ad".a3 INNER JOIN "regional_population" AS "rp" ON "rp".region = "ad".a3 AND "rp".pop_order = 1 INNER JOIN "regional_population" AS "ar" ON "ar".district_id = "ad".district_id ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "account_year", district_id, SUM(amount_lent)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), district_id) SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER::TEXT AS "account_year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("dy".lent_per_account), 2) AS "avg_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district_year" AS "dy" ON "dy".account_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER AND "dy".district_id = "al".district_id GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date) ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount, "l".date AS "approval_date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT loan_id, district, amount, approval_date, loan_rank FROM "ranked" WHERE loan_rank <= 10) SELECT "t".district, "t".amount, "t".approval_date, "x".balance FROM "top_loans" AS "t" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = (SELECT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".loan_id = "t".loan_id) AND "tr".date <= "t".approval_date ORDER BY "tr".date DESC, "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "x" ON TRUE ORDER BY "t".loan_rank ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_clients" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", "disp".account_id, "ca".issued FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "loan_summary" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "profiled" AS (SELECT "cc".client_id, "cc".gender, "cc".birth_date, "cc".card_type, "cc".age_at_issue, COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("ls".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN "ls".number_of_loans IS NULL THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN "cc".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary FROM "card_clients" AS "cc" LEFT JOIN "loan_summary" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "cc".account_id) SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "profiled" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".loan_id = 98832 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 2823) AS "client_accounts" ON "client_accounts".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("res".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "d".driverid AND "lt".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref ORDER BY "d".driverref ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "french_editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990), "driver_laps" AS (SELECT "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, MIN("l".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "fe".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "l".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname) SELECT "fe".date, "dl".forename, "dl".surname, CASE WHEN "dl".fastest_ms IS NOT NULL THEN ("dl".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN ("dl".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (("dl".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN "dl".fastest_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN "dl".fastest_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ("dl".fastest_ms % 1000)::TEXT END AS "fastest_lap" FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" LEFT JOIN "driver_laps" AS "dl" ON "dl".raceid = "fe".raceid AND "dl".fastest_ms > 90000 ORDER BY "fe".date ASC, "dl".surname ASC NULLS LAST, "dl".forename ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d".dob) > 1980 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d2".dob) > 1980 AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "driver_race_best" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "best_lap_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid), "ranked" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, best_lap_ms, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY best_lap_ms ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM "driver_race_best") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".lap_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "yearly_totals" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid GROUP BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year), "career_totals" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("yt".season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "yearly_totals" AS "yt" ON "yt".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career_totals") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM "qualifying" WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p2".milliseconds IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "oldest_winner" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name AS "race_name", "ra".date AS "race_date" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "oldest_winner" AS "ow" ON "ow".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1), "starts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_starts" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "oldest_winner" AS "ow" ON "ow".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) SELECT "ow".forename || ' ' || "ow".surname AS "full_name", "ow".nationality, "fw".race_name, "fw".race_date, "s".total_starts FROM "oldest_winner" AS "ow" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" CROSS JOIN "starts" AS "s" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "re" ON "re".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "re".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' ORDER BY "q".q2::INTERVAL ASC, "q".position ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

WITH "q2_times" AS (SELECT "q".driverid, "q".raceid, "q".q2, MIN("q".q2) OVER () AS "fastest_q2" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '') SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "q2_times" AS "qt" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "qt".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "qt".raceid WHERE "qt".q2 = "qt".fastest_q2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, (SELECT "r2".time FROM "races" AS "r2" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c2" ON "c2".circuitid = "r2".circuitid WHERE "c2".name = 'Shanghai International Circuit' AND "r2".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r2".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r2".time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "r2".time ASC, "r2".year DESC LIMIT 1) AS "scheduled_start_time", "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "runner_up", "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "c".name = 'Shanghai International Circuit' AND "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time = (SELECT MIN("r3".time) FROM "races" AS "r3" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c3" ON "c3".circuitid = "r3".circuitid WHERE "c3".name = 'Shanghai International Circuit' AND "r3".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r3".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r3".time IS NOT NULL) AND "res".position = 2 ORDER BY "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "d".code IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("d".code) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL < INTERVAL '1 minute 38 seconds' LIMIT 501

WITH "race_times" AS (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest_time", MAX(start_time) AS "latest_time" FROM "race_times") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".earliest_time) AS "earliest_circuitref", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".latest_time) AS "latest_circuitref", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("e".latest_time - "e".earliest_time))::BIGINT AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extremes" AS "e" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("r".fastestlapspeed) <> '' ORDER BY "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR BTRIM("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY CASE WHEN POSITION(':' IN "q".q1) > 0 THEN SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2), '.', 1)::NUMERIC + ('0.' || SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2), '.', 2))::NUMERIC ELSE "q".q1::NUMERIC END DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "r".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".position IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_expense_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_expense_total" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "x".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "x".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "x".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".head_count, "a".average_attendance, CASE WHEN "s".head_count > "a".average_attendance::NUMERIC THEN 'more' WHEN "s".head_count < "a".average_attendance::NUMERIC THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT("att".link_to_member) AS "head_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "att" ON "att".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "s" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("att".link_to_member) AS "event_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "att" ON "att".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "semester_counts") AS "a" LIMIT 501

SELECT "cm".department, STRING_AGG("cm".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "cm".major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", STRING_AGG("cm".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "cm".major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE "mc".member_count IS NOT NULL) AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(SUM(COALESCE("mc".member_count, 0))::NUMERIC / COUNT(*), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "cm" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major) AS "mc" ON "mc".link_to_major = "cm".major_id WHERE "cm".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' GROUP BY "cm".department ORDER BY "cm".department ASC LIMIT 501
