SELECT "m".department AS "department", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "attended".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "i".amount END), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id AND "mem".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "mem".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member AS "member_id" FROM "attendance") AS "attended" ON "attended".member_id = "mem".member_id WHERE "m".college = 'College of Engineering' GROUP BY "m".department ORDER BY "m".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "x".link_to_budget WHERE "x".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("i".amount) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "i".link_to_member = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football game%' LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(attendee_count), 'FM999999990.00') AS "average_attendees_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' AND "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

WITH "attendee_counts" AS (SELECT "ma".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma".major_name), "max_count" AS (SELECT MAX(attendee_count) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendee_counts") SELECT "ac".major_name, "ac".attendee_count FROM "attendee_counts" AS "ac" INNER JOIN "max_count" AS "mc" ON "ac".attendee_count = "mc".attendee_count ORDER BY "ac".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_club_members" FROM "major" AS "ma" LIMIT 501

WITH "member_counts" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other' END AS "group_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "events_attended" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) SELECT ROUND(AVG(events_attended) FILTER (WHERE group_name = 'officer'), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(events_attended) FILTER (WHERE group_name = 'other'), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM "member_counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".expense_description) AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "b".remaining < 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "ev".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".total_water, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count::NUMERIC, 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "ev".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "total_water" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE 'Water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "ev".event_id ORDER BY "ev".event_name ASC, "ev".event_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'), "largest_per_event" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event, MAX("b".amount) AS "largest_line_amount" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "chip_events" AS "c" ON "c".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event GROUP BY "b".link_to_event), "winners" AS (SELECT link_to_event FROM "largest_per_event" WHERE largest_line_amount = (SELECT MAX(largest_line_amount) FROM "largest_per_event")) SELECT DISTINCT "e".event_name FROM "winners" AS "w" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "w".link_to_event LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date AS "date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX(expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "roster" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "roster".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "m".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "major_count" FROM "member" AS "roster2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "roster2".link_to_major = "m2".major_id GROUP BY "m2".college) AS "college_counts") ORDER BY "m".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza' GROUP BY "pb".link_to_event) AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("per_event".total_spent, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(CASE WHEN spent <> 0 THEN spent ELSE 0 END) AS "total_spent" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "per_event" ON "per_event".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) <= COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) ORDER BY COUNT("x".expense_id) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "per_type" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "ranked" AS (SELECT type, members_attended, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY members_attended DESC) AS "r" FROM "per_type") SELECT type, members_attended FROM "ranked" WHERE r = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "b".category = 'Food' AND "e".expense_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "item".item_name, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "part" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n" CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT split_part("e".expense_description, ', ', "n".part) AS "item_name") AS "item" WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND ("n".part = 1 OR ("n".part = 2 AND "e".expense_description LIKE '%, %') OR ("n".part = 3 AND "e".expense_description LIKE '%, %, %')) GROUP BY "b".category, "item".item_name ORDER BY "b".category ASC, "item".item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b" WHERE "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "expense".expense_description AS "item name", COUNT(*) AS "times bought" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "member" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "member".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "expense".expense_description ORDER BY "expense".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) FROM "member" AS "mb" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "mb".link_to_major = "m".major_id WHERE "m".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour IS NOT NULL AND "hair".colour IS NOT NULL AND "skin".colour IS NOT NULL AND "eye".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "hair".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "skin".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dhp".power_id FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "dhp" ON "dhp".hero_id = "dc".id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" ON "strength_hp".hero_id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength" ON "strength".id = "strength_hp".power_id WHERE "strength".power_name = 'Super Strength' GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".hero_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT "strength_hp".hero_id)) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "marvel_known" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-'), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".hero_id) AS "hero_count" FROM "marvel_known" AS "mk" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "mk".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "sp".power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM "power_counts" WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM "power_counts") ORDER BY power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_ab".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_ab" ON "ha_ab".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_ab" ON "a_ab".id = "ha_ab".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a_ab".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "c".colour = 'Blue' AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id) >= 10 GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg::NUMERIC))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg <> 0 AND id IN (SELECT "ha".hero_id FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_hulk".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_hulk" ON "ha_hulk".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_hulk" ON "a_hulk".id = "ha_hulk".attribute_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "a_hulk".attribute_name = 'Strength')) LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "s".id, "s".height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "s".height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0), "tallest" AS (SELECT id FROM "ranked" WHERE height_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "tallest" AS "t" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "t".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("power_counts".power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "power_counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "cryo_holders" AS (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis'), "relevant_heroes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id IN (SELECT "hp2".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" INNER JOIN "cryo_holders" AS "ch" ON "ch".hero_id = "hp2".hero_id)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) FROM (SELECT "rh".hero_id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "relevant_heroes" AS "rh" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "rh".hero_id GROUP BY "rh".hero_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_pub" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dc_eye".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel_eye".colour FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "marvel_pub" ON "marvel".publisher_id = "marvel_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "marvel_eye" ON "marvel".eye_colour_id = "marvel_eye".id WHERE "marvel_pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye" ON "shared_eye".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dc_pub".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "r".race = (SELECT "r2".race FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "a".race_id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "r".race NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT "r2".race FROM "superhero" AS "sf" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "gf" ON "sf".gender_id = "gf".id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "sf".race_id = "r2".id WHERE "gf".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "bw" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "bp" ON "bp".id = "bw".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".publisher_id = "bp".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hc" ON "hc".id = "h".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other".publisher_id <> "bp".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "oc" ON "oc".id = "other".eye_colour_id AND "oc".id = "hc".id WHERE "bw".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' LIMIT 501

WITH "target_publisher" AS (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'), "race_counts" AS (SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp" ON "s".publisher_id = "tp".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".race) SELECT race, superhero_count FROM "race_counts" WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM "race_counts") ORDER BY race ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND POSITION(' ' IN BTRIM("s".full_name)) > 0 GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "hp".power_id = "p".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg > 0), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "lightest" AS "l" ON "s".weight_kg = "l".weight_kg LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_power_count" FROM "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown' AND "eye".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "s_brown".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "s_brown" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_hair" ON "brown_hair".id = "s_brown".hair_colour_id WHERE "brown_hair".colour = 'Brown') GROUP BY "eye".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hm" ON "hp".power_id = "hm".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "man" ON "man".id = "hm".hero_id WHERE "man".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT male_patients::NUMERIC / NULLIF(female_patients, 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "l".id END) AS "male_patients", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "l".id END) AS "female_patients" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ua IS NOT NULL AND (("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5))) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".alb IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed age" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage_inpatients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX("rnp"::NUMERIC) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "rnp" <> 'negative'), "qualifying" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."T-BIL" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::NUMERIC = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "highest_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_bilirubin" FROM "qualifying") SELECT "q"."T-BIL", "q".date, "q".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "q".id CROSS JOIN "highest_bilirubin" AS "h" WHERE "q"."T-BIL" = "h".max_bilirubin LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis > 0) AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10) LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "titers" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT id, rnp AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "titers" WHERE titer = (SELECT MAX(titer) FROM "titers") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "id" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY "id" HAVING BOOL_OR("plt" BETWEEN 100 AND 400) AND BOOL_OR("rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "rnp"::INTEGER > 5)) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'MCTD' LIMIT 501

WITH "per_patient" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) AS "test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) SELECT sex, ROUND(AVG(test_dates), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "per_patient" GROUP BY sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(')), "dna_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna::NUMERIC AS "dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".dna IS NOT NULL), "maxima" AS (SELECT id, MAX(dna_level) AS "max_level" FROM "dna_results" GROUP BY id) SELECT "d".id, "d".date, "d".dna_level FROM "dna_results" AS "d" INNER JOIN "maxima" AS "m" ON "m".id = "d".id AND "m".max_level = "d".dna_level ORDER BY "d".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 16), "settings" AS (SELECT "p".admission FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "settings" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hct IS NOT NULL AND (hct <= 29 OR hct >= 52) GROUP BY id) AS "abnormal_hct" ON "abnormal_hct".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::NUMERIC > 16 GROUP BY id) AS "elevated_rnp" ON "elevated_rnp".id = "p".id LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("rnp")::INTEGER AS "highest_anti_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

WITH "overlap_patients" AS (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA,SJS', 'SJS,RA')), "patient_normal_status" AS (SELECT "o".id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "o".id AND "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) AS "normal_result_count" FROM "overlap_patients" AS "o") SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_result_count > 0) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_result_count = 0) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet" FROM "patient_normal_status" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%') AS "sle" ON "sle".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 64) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '1000', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "qualifying_patients" ON "qualifying_patients".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 32 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."Examination Date" - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."Examination Date" = (SELECT MIN("e2"."Examination Date") FROM "examination" AS "e2" WHERE "e2".id = "p".id AND "e2"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND (CASE WHEN "l"."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%' THEN replace(replace("l"."U-PRO", '>=', ''), ' ', '')::NUMERIC WHEN "l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC ELSE NULL END) >= 300 ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l"."T-CHO" AS "T-CHO", "p".admission AS "admission status", "l".id AS "patient ID", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "p".admission ORDER BY "l"."T-CHO" DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "T-CHO", "admission status", "patient ID" FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY CASE "admission status" WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "patient ID" ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_rnp" AS (SELECT "p".id, MAX("l"."rnp"::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "p".id), "maxima" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "max_rnp" FROM "patient_rnp") SELECT "patient_rnp".id, "patient_rnp".highest_rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "patient_rnp" INNER JOIN "maxima" ON "patient_rnp".highest_rnp = "maxima".max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_lab" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_sc170" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "l".id FROM "latest_lab" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_sc170" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "l".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ssa_l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "ssa_l" WHERE "ssa_l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "ssa_l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "ssa_l".id IN (SELECT "pro_l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "pro_l" WHERE "pro_l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "pro_l"."U-PRO" <> '-' AND "pro_l"."U-PRO" <> '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "highest_anti_rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".cre IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_severe_anemia" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, MAX(rnp) OVER () AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible") SELECT "p".id, "r".date, "r".rnp FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rnp = "r".max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg IS NOT NULL AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "measurements_with_normal_ldh" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "l".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "h".hgb < 10), "highest" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex) SELECT id, sex, highest_rnp FROM "highest" WHERE highest_rnp = (SELECT MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

WITH "first_lab" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".got, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "first_lab" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC > 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, date, "U-PRO" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" <> '-' ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC >= 16), "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id GROUP BY "l".id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".gpt IS NULL OR "l".gpt >= 60) = 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".gpt IS NOT NULL AND "l".gpt < 60) > 0) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id ORDER BY "r".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "r".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "l".date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "l".date)) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "p".birthday), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "p".birthday)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "patient_results" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp = 1) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp = 0) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient_results" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "li".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_max" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "highest_dna" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis), "top_score" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_dna) AS "highest_dna" FROM "patient_max") SELECT "pm".id, "pm".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" INNER JOIN "top_score" AS "ts" ON "pm".highest_dna = "ts".highest_dna INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "pm".id AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = "pm".highest_dna ORDER BY "pm".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "setting_patients" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT "sp".setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "li".igg > 900 AND "li".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "setting_patients" AS "sp" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "sp".id GROUP BY "sp".setting ORDER BY "sp".setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "most_recent" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "max_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "current_rnp" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "most_recent" AS "m" ON "l".id = "m".id AND "l".date = "m".max_date WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "current_rnp" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rn = 1 AND "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "r".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest" ON TRUE WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "latest".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "latest".rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND "latest".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh >= 500 AND ("u"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)') OR ("u"."U-PRO" = '+1(30)' AND "u"."U-PRO" = '100')) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC NULLS LAST, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5), "ages" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".admission, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-10-09') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-10-09', 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(completed_age)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "ages" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "number_of_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "sm_lab".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "sm_lab" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "sm_lab".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "sm_lab".id WHERE "sm_lab".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', 'TR') AND (CASE WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 30 WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)', '30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "r".rbc IS NOT NULL AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "n".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "n".rnp <> 'negative' AND "n".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 'FM999999990.0') AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F'), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage_of_men_and_women" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_bond_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "bond" WHERE "bond_type" = '#') AS "triple_molecules" ON "triple_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "atom" WHERE "element" IN ('p', 'br')) AS "element_molecules" ON "element_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE("bond_summary".has_non_single, FALSE) THEN 'all other molecules' ELSE 'every bond is a single bond' END AS "bond_group", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "molecule".label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "molecule".label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" LEFT JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, BOOL_OR(bond_type <> '-') AS "has_non_single" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "bond_summary" ON "bond_summary".molecule_id = "molecule".molecule_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE("bond_summary".has_non_single, FALSE) THEN 'all other molecules' ELSE 'every bond is a single bond' END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".atom_id, "p".element FROM "plus_atoms" AS "p" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "p".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "p".atom_id), "bonded_counts" AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "bonded_atoms" GROUP BY element), "totals" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "plus_atoms"), "ranked" AS (SELECT element, bonded_atom_count, MAX(bonded_atom_count) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "bonded_counts") SELECT "r".element, ROUND(100.0 * "r".bonded_atom_count / "t".total_count, 2) AS "percentage_of_plus_atoms" FROM "ranked" AS "r" CROSS JOIN "totals" AS "t" WHERE "r".bonded_atom_count = "r".max_count ORDER BY "r".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "s".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "s".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element <> 'na' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element = 'n' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id HAVING NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "na" ON "na".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "na".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "na".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "na" ON "na".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "na".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "na".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "eligible_molecules" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "cl_atom" ON "cl_atom"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id2" WHERE "cl_atom"."element" = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "bc".carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".atom_count, "bc".bond_count, "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, "bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, "bc".multiple_bond_count FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "y" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".molecule_id = "y".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "endpoint" ON "endpoint".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "y".element = 'y' AND "h".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("atom_degree".bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degree" LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'c' THEN "a2".element ELSE "a1".element END AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count_of_bonds" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND ("a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AND (CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'c' THEN "a2".element ELSE "a1".element END) <> 'c' GROUP BY CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'c' THEN "a2".element ELSE "a1".element END LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a".atom_id, "a".element HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "qualifying_atoms" GROUP BY element ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
